summary: The Launchpad browser becomes the miner Control Center: Overview, Campaigns, Challenges, Agents, Compute, Connections, Wallet & Identity and Settings, with each campaign deep-linked and tabbed (Overview, Experiments, Metrics, Research Journal, Artifacts, Submission, Logs, Settings), and the controller rehearsal, attached evidence and integration queue moved to a labelled Development area. Every choice is rendered from a new controller document, carbon.control-center.capabilities.v1, derived from the Challenge registry (catalog and descriptions), the shared options operation, the agent transport's own provider and model, the runner profile's runtime and the ledger's budget vocabulary; anything not offered (reserved and deferred Challenges, RunPod and other providers, the remote MCP door) is shown unavailable with its reason and next action. A launch wizard (Challenge, Agent, Model, Compute, Tools & limits, Review, Launch) always sends the chosen challenge and challenge_version through the existing launch operation with the same idempotency key and replay; unset limits are stated as no limit, and the journey's example recipe comes from the campaign's own Challenge description. DEVELOPMENT only: nothing here qualifies, pays, or writes to chain, and the model selection is informational until the launch operation carries one.
